mechanism_of_action: Dual agonist of glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide 1 receptors.
primary_endpoint: Changes from baseline in ALT, AST, K-18, Pro-C3, and adiponectin at 26 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At 26 weeks, tirzepatide significantly reduced ALT (all doses), AST (all except 10 mg), K-18 (5, 10, and 15 mg), and Pro-C3 (15 mg) from baseline. Versus placebo, K-18 decreased significantly with 10 mg and Pro-C3 with 15 mg; ALT decreased significantly versus dulaglutide with 10 and 15 mg. Adiponectin increased significantly versus placebo with 10 and 15 mg.
